name: Bouncy Bopper
notes: A5 (#102, #118). Padded staff with a long reach. From Yellow belt (rooms with minBeltTier 2). 110 Health and 16 power are OK for now, pending the Tester's balance run. Disarmed (Perfect Counter with Disarm), it drops the staff and its next attack is a weak push: same wind-up and warning, power 8. Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
